description: This file manages theme synchronization and metadata generation for the Notesnook project, including cloning/updating theme repositories, reading theme files, and updating theme metadata in a database.

methods.name: syncThemes
methods.description: Clones or pulls the theme repository and triggers metadata generation.

methods.name: generateThemesMetadata
methods.description: Reads theme files, constructs theme metadata objects, updates install counts, and caches the data.
